description: Sachprogramm Windenergie Zone (SAPRO Windenergie) Steiermark is a dataset listed in inspire.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.steiermark.at. The aim of this development programme is to establish regional guidelines for the spatially compatible expansion of wind energy in Styria. The contents of the geodata became legally binding on 16 November 2019. (INSPIRE Annex III). Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Technical programme Wind Energy Zone (SAPRO Wind Energy) Styria" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Steiermark, Raumplanung, Windkraftanlage, OGD - Open Data Österreich, inspireidentifiziert, Windenergie. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2019-11-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-bmlfuw-at.
